anchor.quote: Your sleep tracker confirms your circadian rhythm

claims.rationale: The second-person tracker claim supplies no identified observer, device, procedure, or source and overstates what a generic sleep tracker can confirm.

legacy.quote: "Your sleep tracker confirms your circadian rhythm"
legacy.note: Reader's own devices and lived sleep cycle; no institutional authority invoked. HRV/nootropics same row: descriptive of the reader's calibration regime, not a truth-claim.

anchor.quote: An operating system you didn't write, executing patterns you didn't choose

claims.rationale: The surrounding inherited-code and patch language makes the operating-system comparison explicitly figurative, and no literal computational mechanism is inferred from it.

legacy.quote: "An operating system you didn't write, executing patterns you didn't choose"
legacy.note: Central computing conceit. Declared metaphor operated as the post's frame, never silently upgraded to neuroscience or mechanism. Safe harbor applies.

anchor.quote: the difference between consciousness and self-consciousness

claims.rationale: The article explicitly defines consciousness and self-consciousness as the Noesis distinction between having awareness and examining or rewriting experience; the terms remain internally consistent.

legacy.note: Consciousness-primary distinction; house cosmology by definition (Hermetic core). Not an external science claim.

anchor.quote: Vedic Astronomy: Panchanga, Vimshottari Dasha, Transits

claims.rationale: Within the named Noesis Engine, the listed traditions are declared as perceptual lenses rather than external proof, and the platform taxonomy is internally consistent.

legacy.note: Engine list. Dasha/Panchanga are canonical house structures; the remaining lenses (Human Design, Gene Keys, Biofield, Biorhythm, Face Reading, Tarot, I Ching, Enneagram, Numerology, Sacred Geometry, Sigil Forge) are explicitly framed as lenses — "You simply look through them and notice what you see" (L58). Declared-lens safe harbor; nothing presented as settled fact.

claims.rationale: Kha, Ba, and La are explicitly declared as the engine's three co-arising forces, individually defined, and structurally reused; the count, consequence, and in-post provenance all pass.

legacy.note: Canonical house triadic structure (§4.1). All three forces are defined and operated (Kha/Ba/La, L64-66); the Underpinnings section collapses without it.

claims.rationale: La is explicitly defined inside the Kha-Ba-La house frame as resistance, gravity, and friction that give form; the synonymous definitions cohere without claiming physical proof.

legacy.note: Embodied synonyms defining La (Inertia) within house cosmology. Not a claim that gravity is a fundamental force — the §3.4 watch-list entry does not trigger.

anchor.quote: Sixteen lenses across four directions—256 permutations

claims.rationale: Sixteen lenses paired with four directions yield 64 lens-direction pairings, not 256; moreover, 'permutations' is undefined for the stated operation.

legacy.note: Arithmetic is correct (16×4=256) and derived from house elements, but the §4.4 test is decisive: remove it and the uniqueness argument survives intact on "no two interior landscapes are alike." Precision flourish, not load-bearing structure. ("Permutations" is colloquially loose for lens-direction pairings but not numerically false — not WRONG.)

anchor.quote: A quine is a program whose output is its own source code

claims.rationale: The sentence gives the standard computing definition of a quine, and the concept is consequential to the closing self-reproducing-practice comparison; definition, consequence, and technical provenance pass.

legacy.quote: "A quine is a program whose output is its own source code"
legacy.note: Definition is correct, and the concept is operated structurally: practice → practitioner who becomes the practice (L100). The closing section ("The Quine: Self-Consciousness as Technology") collapses without it. Declared "as"-framing keeps it inside safe harbor.
